heroHeadline: China Completes First-Stage Militarization of Antelope Reef, Largest SCS Base Yet, as PLA Warns Philippine Aircraft Off Scarborough Shoal and Malaysia Cites Balabac Base in Sabah Defense Buildup
heroSubtitle: Satellite imagery reviewed by Reuters and published August 19, 2026 showed China completed the first construction stage at Antelope Reef in the Paracels — a ~6km reclaimed island with a 680m wharf, deep-water harbor, and helipad that analysts say will form part of China's largest South China Sea military base, though Beijing describes it as a civilian weather and research station. Two days later, on August 21, China's PLA Southern Theater Command said it tracked and warned three Philippine government aircraft it accused of illegally intruding into airspace over Scarborough Shoal. Separately, Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said on August 19 that the Philippines' EDCA-backed military build-up on Balabac Island, roughly 50km from Sabah, is pushing Malaysia to reinforce its own defenses with new artillery, radar, and reconnaissance drones. The developments come as the Philippine Department of National Defense and the Chinese Embassy in Manila continued trading accusations over the May Sanjia Steel raid, with Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. accusing the embassy of acting as a 'PR firm' for a Chinese businessman linked to the case.
